$comment: Shared question-normalization contract, replayed identically by three ports: Go normalizeQuestion (agent-go/factlint.go, lint sweep), TS questionKey (src/factbank.ts, serve-time dedup), and JS normalizeQuestion (scripts/export_lib.mjs, export warn report). Algorithm: (1) lowercase, (2) tokenize: every run of non-[a-z0-9] chars collapses to one space and the string is split on whitespace, (3) drop the LEADING token sequence if it matches an entry in interrogative_prefixes (longest match wins, at most one strip, mid-question occurrences are kept), (4) normalized = tokens joined by single spaces. Digits are KEPT: they are incidental identifiers (Apollo 11, Hot 100, 1978) that distinguish questions; stripping them would merge questions that differ only by era or chart. 'number-one' and 'number one' still normalize identically via hyphen -> space.
